text: This lesson covers three ways that a number and a person drift apart: number reassignment, re-registration, and a dormant account.

text: Start with the reassignment.

text: The number belongs to an active customer, so this is not a registration.

text: That is the signal.

text: Re-registration is for one person who arrives under a second number.

text: The usual shape is simple.

text: Someone registers a new number, at level one, and later steps up with MyID.
